remarks: Welcome to one of Darien's most welcoming streets, where neighbors have shared their lives for over 90 years! You'll love the top-rated schools: Ox Ridge Elementary, Middlesex Middle School, and Darien High!  Embrace the charm of nearby Springdale, Stamford, where you can easily stroll to the post office, New Wave Seafood (delicious!), CV's, cozy coffee shops, hair salons, and a variety of tasty restaurants. Plus, the Springdale train station is just a short walk away, offering convenient access to NYC-perfect for commuters!  This adorable Cape Cod home is nestled on a lovely lot and is ready for your personal touch. Imagine expanding it into a spacious four-bedroom, two-bath haven, complete with a fully finished basement-so many possibilities await!  With friendly neighbors and all of Springdale's amenities at your fingertips, life here is truly delightful. Schedule your tour today! Subject to probate. Sold "AS IS."
